bias.en: Uptrend · holding between the 5 and 10-day averages
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 夹在 5 日与 10 日均线之间

read.en: Palantir rose 0.3% on Oct 23 to $196.75, trading between $190.57 and $197.49. It is just above the falling 5-day ($196.3) and above the rising 30-day ($190.9), 100-day ($159.6) and 200-day ($153.2) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($198.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 but is above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($207.35), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: Palantir 10月23日上涨 0.3%，收于 $196.75，盘中区间 $190.57–197.49。股价略高于下行的 5 日均线（$196.3），并位于上行的 30 日（$190.9）、100 日（$159.6）和 200 日均线（$153.2）上方，低于下行的 10 日均线（$198.7）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$207.35），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The $190.6 low dipped under $194.5 before the close recovered above the 5-day. Resistance is $197.5–198.7 (Oct 23 high, 10-day), then $202.6–203.6 (Oct 16, 21 and 22 highs) and $207.4 (SAR). Support is $194.5–196.3 (Oct 22 low, 5-day), then $189.4–190.9 (Oct 20, 21 and 23 lows, 30-day) and $184.5. A close above $203.6 would open $207–213; a close below $189.4 would open $184.5.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR；52周高点 $212.9（10月12日）
